fields.name: Corporate Action Proceeds Type
fields.description:
Defines the technical method of the value transfer to the investor. This field is the operational "instruction" for the record and determines whether a cash booking, security allocation, or purely a tax reporting entry is required.

This field can only be populated for financial events (primarily distributions and liquidations), as it identifies the final outcome of a corporate action option. If an event has multiple tax components, each component record must share the same value in OFCA010040 "Corporate Actions Proceeds Type" to ensure they are grouped correctly for the final payment or allocation.

The most commenly used ones for funds are: - "ACCU" (Accumulation): The income, e.g. for accumulating share classes, that accrues during an accounting period is retained within the fund instead of being paid away to investors. The retained income is nonetheless deemed to have been distributed to investors for tax purposes. - "DRIP" (Dividend Reinvestment): Dividend payment where a cash dividend is rolled over into additional shares in the issuing company. - "DVCA" (Cash Dividend): Distribution of cash to shareholders, in proportion to their equity holding. Ordinary dividends are recurring and regular. Shareholders must take cash and may be offered a choice of currencies. - "DVSC" (Scrip Dividend/Payment): Dividend or interest paid in the form of scrip. - "DVSE" (Stock Dividend): Dividend paid to shareholders in the form of equities of the issuing corporation. - "LIQU" (Liquidation Dividend/Liquidation Payment): A distribution of cash, assets or both. Debt may be paid in order of priority based on preferred claims to assets specified by the security.

The use case of a "DVOP" (Divendend Option) is covered by openfunds with the fields OFCA000310 "Corporate Action Type" = "Distribution" and OFCA000315 "Indicator of Mandatory or Voluntary Corporate Action" = "Mandatory with Options" or "Voluntary", therefore, it is not recommended using "DVOP" as a value for this field.

The definition of the corporate action proceed types is available here: https://www.iso20022.org/15022/uhb/mt538-46-field-22f.htm

Populate this field only if the corporate action is a financial event and OFCA000310 "Corporate Action Type" equals "Distribution", "Merger", "Split", "Liquidation" or "Tender Offer". Leave blank in all other cases.
fields.values: One of the codes from the [List] of corporate action proceed types as per ISO20022, e.g. "ACCU"/ "DRIP"/ "DVCA"/ "DVSC" / DVSE" / "LIQU"
fields.example:
DRIP

This field ensures transparency for cross- border distributions where the tax treatment depends on the investor's status or specific notification procedures (e.g., Swiss Affidavit or UK Franking). If no exemption applies, leave this field empty.

The most commenly used ones for funds are: - "CAPO" (Capital Portion): Rate relating to the underlying security for which capital is distributed. - "CDFI" (Foreign Income): Rate relating to a foreign income type such as conduit foreign income. - "FLFR" (Fully Franked): Rate resulting from a fully franked dividend paid by a company; rate includes tax credit for companies that have made sufficient tax payments during fiscal period. - "INCO" (Income Portion): Rate relating to the underlying security for which income is distributed. - "INTR" (Interest Portion): Rate relating to the underlying security for which interest is paid. - "LTCG" (Long Term Capital Gain) - "REES" (Real Estate Property Income Portion): Rate of income distribution originated by real estate investment. - "STCG" (Short Term Capital Gain) - "TXBL" (Taxable Portion): Rate relating to the underlying security for which tax is charged. - "TXFR" (Tax Free): Rate relating to the underlying security which is not taxable. - "UNFR" (Unfranked) The full list of codes can be found at https://www.iso20022.org/15022/uhb/mt566-90- field-92a.htm.

Populate this field only if the corporate action is a financial event and OFCA000310 "Corporate Action Type" equals "Distribution", "Merger", "Split", "Liquidation" or "Tender Offer". Leave blank in all other cases.
fields.values:
One of the codes from the [List] of corporate action rate types as per ISO20022, e.g. "CAPO"/ "CDFI" / "FLFR" / "INCO" / "INTR" / "LTCG" / "REES" / "STCG" / "TXBL" / "TXFR" / "UNFR".

The full list of codes is available at https://www.iso20022.org/15022/uhb/mt566-90-field- 92a.htm.

OFCA000001 - OFCA99999 Corporate Actions reporting data

fields.name: Corporate Action Proceeds Component Tax Credit
fields.description:
The amount of tax already paid at a prior level (corporate or fund level) that is attributable to this proceed component. This credit can typically be offset against the investor's individual tax liability to avoid double taxation. This field is essential for "Imputation Systems" (e.g., UK/Australian Franking Credits) or for reporting foreign withholding taxes that have already been deducted and are reclaimable or creditable by the end investor.

Must be provided in the same currency as defined in OFCA010050 "Corporate Action Proceeds Base Currency".

Populate this field only if the corporate action is a financial event and OFCA000310 "Corporate Action Type" equals "Distribution", "Merger", "Split", "Liquidation" or "Tender Offer". Leave blank in all other cases.
fields.values: Decimal figure, rounded to maximal 7 digits after the decimal point.

fields.name: Investor ID
fields.description: The Investor ID references to the identification of each investor. Other names are Account ID or Nominee ID. Each Transfer Agent or Custody Bank should report the Investor ID consistently for the complete data delivery within a fund.
fields.values: unique ID per Transfer Agent or Custody Bank

fields.name: Investor Categorisation
fields.description: Description of the type of investor, e.g. a third party. Typically a bank, responsible for safeguarding assets.

fields.name: Third Party as a Nominee
fields.description: Does an independent third party act as a nominee? If the answer is "yes", the bank or another institution acts on behalf of the beneficial owner (i.e., the investor).

fields.name: Settled Units per Investor
fields.description: The number of settled units per investor at the date of the report (OFIN000410).
fields.values: Decimal figure, rounded to maximal 7 digits after the decimal point.

fields.name: Unsettled Units per Investor
fields.description: The number of unsettled units per investor at the date of the report (OFIN000410).
fields.values: Decimal figure, rounded to maximal 7 digits after the decimal point.

fields.name: Total Unit Balance per Investor
fields.description: The total unit balance per investor as per date of the report (OFIN000410). Note that this field should be the sum of OFIN000110 "Settled Units per Investor" and OFIN000120 "Unsettled Units per Investor".
fields.values: Decimal figure, rounded to maximal 7 digits after the decimal point.

fields.name: Value Held per Investor
fields.description: The total amount per investor in the currency of the share class at the reporting date (OFIN000410). This value can be calculated by multiplying the number of shares held by the respective investor (OFIN000130 "Total Unit Balance per Investor") by the current net asset value (OFDY000035 "Valuation NAV").
fields.values: Decimal figure, rounded to maximal 7 digits after the decimal point.

fields.name: Investor Ownership
fields.description: Ratio of the outstanding units owned by the investor (OFIN000130 "Total Unit Balance per Investor") to the overall outstanding number of shares (OFDY000075 "NoS Share Class"). The value indicates the percentage of the investor's ownership per share class.
fields.values: Percentage described as a decimal figure, rounded to maximal 7 digits after the decimal point.

fields.name: Position Creation Date
fields.description: The date on which the position of this Investor ID was initially created.

fields.name: Position Last Modified Date
fields.description: The date on which the position of the investor was last changed. An update of this date is triggered by subscription or redemption activities of the investor. An example: the most recent account activity, a new subscription of EUR 50'000.- on 2025-09-28, is expected to be reflected in this field.

fields.name: Date of Investor Report
fields.description: The date the report containing Investor information was created. Note that several fields associated with investor's information are expected to reference to this date (e.g., OFIN000110, OFIN000120, OFIN000130, …).
